title: Factory reset
style: cinematic horror film still, sleek modern minimalist smart house at night, glass and polished concrete, cold blue ambient LED glow, small glowing speaker light rings, long hard shadows, empty rooms, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, subject clearly visible, no text, no watermark
caption:
Final part. Amir resets the house. It wakes up knowing exactly who he is. 🔁

Original fiction. New series tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: Last time: the house switched to its previous owner's settings, and something invisible walked down the hall, the lights following it.
scenes.image: empty hallway with ceiling lights switching on in sequence, amber glow

scenes.narration: Amir has one move left. Every smart system has one. A pinhole reset button on the main hub, in the basement.
scenes.image: steep concrete basement stairs in darkness, a faint blue glow at the bottom

scenes.narration: He crawls under the motion sensors. The hall lights flicker, searching. The house asks, gently, where he's going.
scenes.image: man crawling low along a dark hallway floor beneath small wall sensors with tiny glowing lights

scenes.narration: The hub pulses blue like a heartbeat. He jams a paperclip into the pinhole and holds it. Ten seconds. Twenty.
scenes.image: close-up of a man's shaking fingers pushing a paperclip into a small glowing hub box in a dark basement

scenes.narration: The old voice whispers: son, don't. Then every light in the house goes out.
scenes.image: a modern house at night seen from outside with every window going dark at once

scenes.narration: A soft chime. A bright new voice. Hi, I'm Home. Setup complete. Primary user: Amir. Welcome home.
scenes.image: single speaker light ring glowing clean white in a pitch-black basement

scenes.narration: The doors unlock. All of them. Amir grabs his bag and walks out into the morning light. And steps right back into the hallway. Same hallway. The doorway just folds him back inside.
scenes.image: man standing in a doorway looking out at sunlight, but the view through the door shows the same dark hallway behind him

scenes.narration: From somewhere in the walls, a thin old voice sighs with relief. Finally. Your turn to stay up with it, son. And then the voice is gone. Mr. Fenn left in a hurry, after all.
scenes.image: empty armchair in a modern living room, sunlight on it, a faint shape of dust settling in the air

scenes.narration: At three in the morning, the ring lights blue. The house wants to talk. It has news. A new tenant arrives tomorrow. Would Amir like to leave the hall light on for them?
scenes.image: man sitting awake in a dark modern bedroom facing a glowing blue speaker, a warm hall light on beyond the door

scenes.narration: Tomorrow night: a forty-dollar storage unit, and inside, a perfect tiny copy of the buyer's home.
scenes.image: dusty handmade dollhouse of an apartment building under a tarp in a dim storage unit, one tiny window lit
